summary: In March 2025, ICE and the State Department began arresting and revoking the visas and green cards of foreign students and scholars across the US over pro-Palestine protest and speech, often using targets named by doxing sites.

evidence.note: Khalil arrested by ICE at Columbia housing in March 2025, the opening case
Khalil's role in the 2024 campus encampment protests as background to his targeting
Chung, a green card holder from South Korea, hides and sues to stop her deportation
State Department directive ordering social media screening of student visa holders
Canary Mission doxing profiles described as a source of ICE targets
Ozturk seized on a street after co-writing a student op-ed, sent to Louisiana detention
Southern Illinois University advises international students to avoid protests

notes: Format: this is an It Could Happen Here episode (Garrison Davis, James Stout) republished in the BtB feed, which could read as crossover, but formats.yaml names this exact title as a current-affairs example, so I followed that. ICE is the primary subject, so roles stay empty. Ozturk's and Chung's birth years are not stated in the packet (Chung is 21), so their starts are null.
